name: com.8izips.fmath
description: Deterministic fixed-point math for rollback netcode: 32-bit state (ffloat Q16.16, funit Q1.30, fAngle Angle32) with 64-bit intermediates. No Burst, no native plugin, no UnityEngine dependency in the core assembly.

samples.description: MonoBehaviour that prints the raw-hash, 10000-tick simulation hash and benchmarks on a device build (Windows / Android / iOS IL2CPP).
